We couldn't be happier!

facts.about_text: Hello Neighbors, my name is Bret, I've been a Tile Specialist for over 25 years in Indian River County.Owner/Operator. I'm Licensed and Insured. Tilesense2@gmail.com I specialize in: Showers/backsplashes/floors Shower Pan Specialist Leak Detection/leaky showers Cracked Tiles Grout Cleaning Grout Removal/Replace Grout Staining Counter top polishing/cleaning Commercial Grout Cleaning No job is too small Will work weekends!! My Facebook page is Tilesense many more pictures on my Facebook!!!
